mapper.sql: story_id, user_no, file_id, media_type, thumbnail_file_id, duration_sec, caption, created_at, expires_at, is_deleted, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_story ( user_no, file_id, media_type, thumbnail_file_id, duration_sec, caption, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{fileId}, #{mediaType}, #{thumbnailFileId}, #{durationSec}, #{caption}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ultary_story WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND
SELECT FROM ultary_story WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND ORDER BY created_at ASC, story_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_story WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND

SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_file_id AS profileFileId, COUNT(s.story_id) AS storyCount FROM ultary_neighbor n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.receiver_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN ultary_story s ON s.user_no = u.user_no AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.expires_at > NOW() WHERE n.requester_user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND n.status = 'ACCEPTED' GROUP BY u.user_no, u.nickname, u.profile_file_id ORDER BY MAX(s.created_at) DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_story s WHERE s.user_no = #{ownerUserNo} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.expires_at > NOW() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_story_view v WHERE v.story_id = s.story_id AND v.viewer_user_no = #{viewerUserNo} )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (requester_user_no = #{userNoA} AND receiver_user_no = #{userNoB}) OR (requester_user_no = #{userNoB} AND receiver_user_no = #{userNoA}) )
